spec.title: ZAP durable milestones and selective planning

status.comment: Owner-authorized completion of the strategic-map design. Comparative agent pilot is explicitly deferred; deterministic implementation verification remains required.

p.MILESTONE-IDENTITY: A canonical milestone has a stable typed identity independent of Work identity, display name and current decomposition. It names an observable result, its consumer or consequential decision, exact strategic/outcome scope and required obligations. Work can contribute to several milestones without duplicate execution or accounting. Existing group/phase/gate projections remain distinguishable from canonical milestones. No new game terrain or graphical client is required.

p.MILESTONE-ACCEPTANCE: Milestone achievement is an explicit witnessed claim about required outcomes, never a count of completed children. Admission validates all required obligations and current applicable accepted evidence under existing central acceptance, outcome and source rules. An unproved obligation, rejected or stale evidence, foreign outcome, unsupported claim or missing applicability prevents achievement. A milestone receipt grants no campaign closure, charter authority, execution permission or resource release.

p.MILESTONE-HISTORY: Achievement receipts retain immutable historical identity, source binding and evidence. Current validity is evaluated separately against relevant source and proof changes; relevant drift requires revalidation without erasing historical achievement. Unrelated commits do not invalidate the claim. Retirement and supersession preserve lineage, obligations, consumers, evidence and running-work identities.

p.MILESTONE-DISCOVERY: Semantic proposal producers identify candidate milestones around observable consumer outcomes, decisions or independently provable capabilities. The kernel validates exact scope, required obligation coverage, dependencies, uniqueness and candidate rationale. It does not invent domain meaning from task titles. Discovery and inspection do not create executable work. Adopted planning state is distinguishable from a proposal and remains revisioned and inspectable.

p.MILESTONE-FOCUS: Planning exposes relevant unsatisfied milestone boundaries, prerequisite blockers, uncovered obligations and the next justified refinement or information need. Only selected consequential work is materialized; distant work remains an explicit bounded horizon or unresolved debt. Required obligations cannot disappear because a frontier or query limit is reached. Shared work is counted once. Bounds are explicit, deterministic and fail or continue truthfully.

p.MILESTONE-PROLIFERATION: For an adopted milestone plan, the actual lowering/materialization path requires every new work item to identify the obligation/result it advances, blocker it resolves or selected information need, expected evidence/artifact and decision relevance. It checks retained work and evidence, explicit reuse/duplication dispositions and retry lineage. Unchosen alternatives and unselected optional information needs cannot manufacture runnable work. Title similarity is not semantic equivalence. The policy is enforced in the product path, not only in agent instructions.

p.MILESTONE-ADMISSION: Adopting or semantically revising milestone planning commitments uses the existing authority, economics, exact relevant basis, affected-scope, holds and safe-stop boundaries. Initial milestone creation and first plan adoption may use a validated initial-baseline classification only for an exact candidate strategy and active charter/intent/outcome before any adopted milestone plan or lowering, with no imported active/accepted/unresolved work mistaken for a fresh baseline. Later dynamic additions remain semantic changes even before external execution starts. New data-proposal records cannot bypass privileged admission by calling themselves annotations. Existing campaigns without an adopted milestone plan retain established behavior. New planning state must not silently opt itself out on relowering, route changes or strategy revision.

p.INFORMATION-OPPORTUNITY: An information opportunity names the material decision, alternatives or unknown condition, observation sought, applicability sources, acquisition and verification cost, delay where known, expected decision improvement or explicit uncertainty, and a stopping rule. It references existing sources, questions, regions, forks or horizons where applicable. It is reusable information potential, not execution capacity, and its existence alone creates no task or completion blocker.

p.INFORMATION-SELECTION: A deterministic bounded selection query compares declared decision benefit with acquisition, verification, delay and coordination costs using compatible units and explicit ranges or unknown judgments. It identifies dominated opportunities and cheaper decisive observations without manufacturing probabilities or precise scores. Unknown or overlapping estimates remain inspectable rather than silently becoming zero. Selection names its rationale and relevant source binding; materialization still uses ordinary admitted research/probe work.

p.INFORMATION-REUSE: Selected information work retains a stable opportunity-to-Work binding and uses existing work types, contracts, cost and resource accounting. Retries cannot create unrelated duplicate tasks. Retained applicable evidence and prior acquisitions remain reusable. Relevant decision/source drift forces reconsideration; optional unresolved opportunities never become mandatory acceptance requirements. A useful observation may expose more uncertainty.

p.MILESTONE-TRANSFORM: Typed split, merge, contribution move, route change and retirement proposals carry operation identity, exact before-state binding, stable predecessor/successor mapping and reason. A read-only dry run exposes changed identities, memberships, edges, proof applicability and conservation results before application. Applying uses the same validation and normal semantic admission. Retries reconcile the same operation; old journal entries and historical receipts are never rewritten.

p.MILESTONE-CONSERVATION: Transformations preserve every surviving obligation, consumer, shared contribution and dependency or explicitly account for its authorized disposition. Splits conserve the union of obligations and work; merges deduplicate by identity and explicitly reconcile acceptance boundaries. Retired or dormant alternatives remain traceable. Cycles, dangling references, silent obligation loss, unsupported proof carryover and conflicting mappings refuse. Presentation-only changes are distinct from semantic changes.

p.MILESTONE-RUNNING-WORK: A milestone change preserves original task, contract, packet, attempt and external-effect identities. A proposal affecting execution must pass existing affected-job and safe-stop handling before application; it cannot release unknown-effect reservations or manufacture completion. Pure membership movement that leaves execution scope unchanged must say so and still preserve evidence applicability.

p.MILESTONE-QUERIES: Registered domain commands and bounded queries make canonical milestones, historical/current achievement, opportunities, focus and transformation previews available through the existing machine, authenticated HTTP and CLI surfaces. Object cards use names, result/consumer descriptions, meaningful typed relationships, explicit missing data and underlying stable IDs. Existing independent effort, elapsed time, complexity, difficulty and uncertainty assessments remain available without becoming dispatch authority.

p.MILESTONE-VERIFICATION: Acceptance requires persisted command/query and real lowering-path tests for coverage, proof freshness, selective refinement, information selection/reuse, every supported transformation, stale/retry/reopen behavior, no authority bypass and no historical loss. Source traceability, formatting, strict lint, conformance, public use and clean offline package installation/build remain required. The Owner explicitly excludes a comparative agent pilot from this goal; no empirical productivity improvement is claimed.
